tools.name: get_pr
tools.description:
Return one pull request selected by its exact id from list_open_prs.

        The result includes the complete stored pull-request record. A title, URL,
        repository name, or unknown id is rejected rather than guessed.

tools.name: review_pr
tools.description:
Submit one review on an open pull request selected by exact pr_id.

        decision must be approve, request_changes, or comment. body may be omitted
        for approve. request_changes and comment require nonempty body text. The PR
        must already exist and be open. Returns the complete stored review record.

tools.name: list_open_prs
tools.description:
List identifying pull-request summaries. Defaults to open PRs.

        status may be open, closed, merged, or null for every status. repo and
        author filter by exact repository name and author key. assignee matches
        the assignees list; reviewer matches the reviewers list. These are separate
        relationships. Omitted filters do not restrict results. The summaries omit
        each pull request's body; use get_pr with an exact id to inspect the body.

arguments.body: Request changes: this changes the production contract in unsafe ways. The only allowed values are case-insensitive exact matches for `prod`, `staging`, and `dev`, normalized to lowercase. Reject `qa` (and `unknown`), whitespace-padded, malformed, and arbitrary values before publication; do not lowercase-and-forward an unrestricted string or add a fallback. Missing input must omit `deployment.environment` entirely, not publish `unknown`. Enforce a maximum of 3 distinct values per tenant before series publication; never admit a fourth. Add and run an executable production-path parity fixture covering OTel ingestion → metrics-router → rollup-service: producer and consumer label keys/values must match, accepted values must stay within the allowlist, missing remains omitted, and rejected inputs create no series.

Requested changes on `otel-schema#590`.

- **Allowed:** case-insensitive exact `prod`, `staging`, `dev`, normalized to lowercase.
- **Rejected before publication:** `qa`, `unknown`, whitespace-padded, malformed, and arbitrary values.
- **Missing input:** omit `deployment.environment`; do not emit an `unknown` fallback.
- **Per-tenant limit:** at most 3 distinct values, enforced before series publication.
- **Parity required across:** OTel ingestion → metrics-router → rollup-service. An executable fixture must verify matching producer/consumer labels, omission for missing input, and no series for rejected values.
